mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS articleCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN examine_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN examine_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passedCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN examine_status > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejectedCount, IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) AS viewCount, IFNULL(SUM(like_count), 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(SUM(comment_count), 0) AS commentCount, IFNULL(SUM(favorite_count), 0) AS favoriteCount, IFNULL(SUM(danmaku_count), 0) AS danmakuCount, IFNULL(MAX(create_time), 0) AS lastPublishTime FROM article WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status}

SELECT a.id AS id, a.title AS title, a.img_url AS imgUrl, a.type AS type, a.category AS category, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime, a.duration AS duration, a.examine_status AS examineStatus, IFNULL(a.view_count, 0) AS viewCount, IFNULL(a.like_count, 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(a.comment_count, 0) AS commentCount, IFNULL(a.favorite_count, 0) AS favoriteCount, IFNULL(a.danmaku_count, 0) AS danmakuCount, IFNULL(a.dislike_count, 0) AS dislikeCount, IFNULL(pv.cnt, 0) AS periodView, IFNULL(pl.cnt, 0) AS periodLike, IFNULL(pc.cnt, 0) AS periodComment, IFNULL(pf.cnt, 0) AS periodFavorite, IFNULL(pd.cnt, 0) AS periodDanmaku FROM article a
WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = #{status} ORDER BY ${orderSql}

SELECT a.category AS category, COUNT(*) AS articleCount, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(pv.cnt, 0)), 0) AS periodView, IFNULL(SUM(a.view_count), 0) AS viewCount FROM article a
WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = #{status} GROUP BY a.category ORDER BY periodView DESC, viewCount DESC
